title: 2023 Forbes Holiday Cocktail Guide
text: 2023 forbes holiday cocktail guide source: forbes this document contains 13 holiday cocktail recipes from acclaimed bartenders and bars around the world, including: cocktails included 1. untitled amaro cocktail - amaro santoni, bourbon, dry vermouth 2. kindred joy (connaught bar, london) - patrón silver, three spirit spark, ancho reyes, tomato liqueur, yuzu syrup, pink grapefruit soda 3. the turtledove (yacht club, denver) - hamilton black jamaican rum, verdelho madeira, campari, pineapple juice, lime juice, cinnamon syrup 4. potter's old fashioned (martiny's, new york) - chai tea and butter-washed bourbon, coconut palm syrup, abbott's bitters 5. coca-cola sour (lyaness, london) - beefeater gin, lemon juice, orange juice, campari, pomegranate-and-pepper caramel, egg white 6. parsnip (himkok, oslo) - parsnip-infused buffalo trace bourbon, maple syrup, angostura cocoa bitters 7. tannenbaum negroni (swift borough, london) - spiced reposado tequila, egg whites, panela syrup, pineapple juice, lime juice, panela salt crumbles

title: 3 Ingredient  Fermented Ginger Beer
text: 3 ingredient fermented ginger beer <https://youtu.be/lqpko6a3wh4 <https://www.joshuaweissman.com/recipes/best-homemade-ginger-beer-recipe ingredients ‘ginger bug’ ingredients, first day: 480ml (500ml) filtered water 30ml (28g) granulated sugar 30ml (22g) finely chopped or grated ginger (skin on is fine) ginger bug feeding, every 24 hours: 30ml (28g) granulated sugar 30ml (22g) finely chopped or grated ginger (skin on is fine) ginger beer: 2 quarts filtered water 300ml plus 30ml (273g) granulated sugar see notes 60ml (54g) ginger, grated 120ml (110g) strained ginger bug liquid juice of 3 lemons notes on sugar in ginger beer: you're welcome to make the ginger beer much less sweet if you prefer. i would say the lowest you can go on sugar is 120ml (170g). instructions to cultivate your own wild yeast, combine water with sugar, ginger and place in a 1-quart glass/plastic container. mix together until the sugar is dissolved, and cover with a cheesecloth. let it sit for 24 hours. moving forward, add the same amount of ginger and sugar every 24 hours until it becomes fizzy. this should take about 2-3 days. once the ginger bug is fizzy, pour 2 quarts of water into a large pot. to that, add sugar and ginger. bring up to a boil and then reduce the heat to a simmer and let it sit for 5-8 minutes. let it cool down naturally until it reaches room temperature, leaving all of the ingredients in there to steep. strain your liquid through a fine mesh colander. make sure to press out the juices. next, add in 120ml of your strained ginger bug and the juice of 3 lemons. mix together until thoroughly combined and transfer that mixture to some flip-top bottles. make sure to leave 2 inches of head room. let them sit out at room temperature with the flip bottle tops locked, for 3-6 days or until they’re fizzy. once they’ve reached that point, you can refrigerate them; but make sure you’re opening the top and burping them once a day.

title: 6 Sourdough Bread Rolls
text: 6 sourdough bread rolls ingredients - 165 gr sourdough starter (83 gr flour + 83 ml water) - 582 gr flour (80% whole wheat, bread flour, or similar blend) - 12 gr salt - 385 ml water - rice flour for dusting instructions 1. at 21:00 in the evening, add 83 gr flour and 83 ml water to your sourdough starter jar to activate it. 2. place a dutch oven in the oven and set it to turn on automatically at 06:15 and preheat to 220°c for 1 hour. 3. premix the 582 gr flour and 12 gr salt in a bowl and prepare 385 ml water overnight to allow chlorine to dissipate. 4. at 07:15, remove the dough from the fridge, score it, place it in the dutch oven covered, and bake covered for 20 minutes. 5. mix the pre-prepared flour, water, sourdough starter, and salt together to form the dough. 6. at 07:35, uncover the bread in the oven and give the dough a quick 1-minute knead. 7. bake uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes until the loaf is golden and baked through, then remove from the oven. 8. perform a lamination by giving the dough one major stretch and fold before shaping it into a dough ball and returning it to the bowl. 9. at 13:20, quick pre-shape the dough and divide it into 6 equal rolls, then let them rest for 10 minutes. 10. at 13:30, shape each roll and roll in rice flour, then place in a dusted banneton basket. 11. at 15:00, once the dough has expanded and feels springy, place the rolls in the fridge until ready to bake.

title: Air Fryer Baba Ganoush Eggplant
text: air fryer baba ganoush eggplant ingredients - 1 medium eggplant, halved lengthwise - 2ml kosher salt - 82ml olive oil, divided - 1 bulb garlic - 60ml tahini (sesame seed paste) - 30ml lemon juice, or more to taste - 1ml ground cumin - 1ml smoked paprika - 30ml crumbled feta cheese - 15ml chopped fresh parsley - 2ml lemon zest instructions 1. sprinkle cut sides of eggplant with salt and let stand for 20 to 30 minutes, then blot dry with paper towels. 2. preheat an air fryer to 204°c (200 degrees c). 3. brush cut sides of eggplant with 15ml olive oil, cut off the top 1/4 inch from the garlic bulb to expose the cloves, brush cloves with 8ml olive oil, wrap bulb in aluminum foil, and place eggplant and garlic in the air fryer basket. 4. cook in the preheated air fryer until eggplant and garlic are tender and eggplant is deep golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes, then remove and allow to cool for about 10 minutes. 5. scoop flesh from eggplant and place into the bowl of a food processor, add tahini, lemon juice, 4 cloves of roasted garlic, remaining 60ml olive oil, cumin, and paprika, and pulse to a moderately smooth consistency. 6. top with feta cheese, parsley, and lemon zest before serving.

title: Almond Pecan Sheet Cake
text: almond pecan sheet cake source: iambaker.net ingredients - 240ml (226g) unsalted butter - 240ml water - 480ml (250g) all-purpose flour - 480ml (400g) granulated sugar - 120ml (115g) sour cream - 5ml almond extract - 2ml salt - 5ml baking soda - 2 large eggs, (must be room temperature) - 120ml (113g) salted butter - 60ml (61g) milk - 960ml (500g) confectioners' sugar, (sifted) - 2ml almond extract - 240ml chopped pecans instructions 1. preheat oven to 177°c. 2. in a large saucepan, bring 240ml butter and water to a boil. once butter is melted and there is a low rolling boil, remove from heat.  3. in this order: stir in flour, sugar, sour cream, 5ml almond extract, salt, baking soda, and eggs. whisk after each addition until smooth.  4. pour batter into a prepared 10x15-inch baking pan. 5. bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 22 minutes, or until cake is golden brown and an inserted toothpick is removed with a few crumbs. (not wet)  6. combine 120ml butter and milk in a saucepan; bring to a low rolling boil, then remove from heat.  7. add in sugar 240ml at a time making sure to whisk after each addition.  8. add in 2ml almond extract. whisk well. it will be similar to a gravy consistency.  9. stir in pecans. spread frosting over warm cake.

title: Ancient Cookies
text: ancient cookies ingredients - 200 g ghee (or unsalted butter), melted and slightly cooled - 175 g honey - 360 g khorasan flour (approx. 2½ cups) - 5ml ground cardamom (6-8 pods) - 1ml salt - 120 ml date spread (or thick date paste) - 90 g unsalted pistachios, finely chopped - 12 whole pistachios for topping - 3 pinches ground cumin instructions 1. in a small bowl, combine the date spread, chopped pistachios, and ground cumin and mix until well incorporated. 2. in a large mixing bowl, whisk together the melted ghee and honey until smooth. 3. in a separate bowl, sift the khorasan flour, ground cardamom, and salt. 4. gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until a soft dough forms. 5. if the dough feels too soft, refrigerate for 10 minutes to firm up. 6. preheat your oven to 170°c (171°c) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 7. divide the dough into 12 equal portions. 8. flatten each portion into a disc, place a teaspoon of the date-pistachio filling in the center, and fold the dough over to seal, shaping it into a ball. 9. place the cookies seam-side down on the prepared baking sheet. 10. gently press a whole pistachio onto the top of each cookie for decoration. 11. bake in the preheated oven for 16–18 minutes, or until the cookies are lightly golden on the bottom and just set on top. 12. allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Apple Crumble
text: apple crumble ingredients - 3 medium cooking apples - 170g granulated sugar - 113g butter or cooking margarine - 113g self-raising flour - 4ml cinnamon (optional) - 120ml rolled oats or corn flakes (optional) instructions 1. preheat your oven to 180°c / 177°c / gas mark 5. 2. mix the butter or margarine with the flour in a dry bowl using a fork until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs, taking about three minutes. 3. if adding optional oatmeal or corn flakes, mix them in now. 4. add 113g of sugar to the mixture and mix it all together with the fork. 5. peel the apples and cut each one into four parts, then cut out the core from each section. 6. slice the apple quarters into about six slices per section. 7. put the apple slices into the casserole dish and sprinkle with cinnamon if using. 8. sprinkle the remaining 57g of sugar evenly over the apples. 9. evenly spread the crumble mixture over the sugared apples. 10. place the dish into the preheated oven for around 40 minutes. 11. optional: place the apple crumble under a hot grill for 30 to 45 seconds to brown the topping, watching carefully to avoid burning. 12. leave the crumble to cool for at least 15 minutes before serving. 13. serve hot or cold with ice cream, cream, or custard.

title: Apple Pecan Coffee Cake
text: apple pecan coffee cake ingredients - 2½ cups all-purpose flour - 1¾ cups sugar - 1½ tsp baking soda - 1ml salt - 2ml baking powder - 4ml cinnamon - 2ml cloves - 2ml allspice - 120ml butter, softened - 120ml buttermilk - 1½ cups applesauce - 2 eggs - 2 granny smith apples, peeled and diced - 120ml brown sugar - 10ml cinnamon - 30ml flour - 30ml butter, melted - 120ml chopped pecans instructions 1. preheat oven to 177°c and grease a 9x13 baking pan. 2. whisk together flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves, and allspice in a large bowl. 3. add butter, buttermilk, and applesauce to the dry ingredients and mix until combined. 4. beat in eggs one at a time. 5. fold in the diced apples. 6. pour batter into the prepared pan. 7. combine all streusel ingredients in a small bowl and mix until crumbly. 8. sprinkle streusel evenly over the batter. 9. bake for 45–50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, then cool before serving.

title: Apple Cream Pie
text: apple cream pie ingredients - 9-inch unbaked pie crust - 5-6 medium apples, pared and quartered - 15ml lemon juice - 240ml brown sugar - 60ml flour - 2ml cinnamon - pinch salt - 240ml cream instructions 1. sprinkle lemon juice over apples and place apples rounded side up in pastry-lined pie pan. 2. combine brown sugar, flour, cinnamon and salt. 3. sprinkle 180ml of the mixture over the apples. 4. pour cream over the apples. 5. sprinkle with remaining brown sugar mixture. 6. bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake until the apples are tender, 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Armenian Perok Cake
text: armenian perok cake ingredients - 250g unsalted softened butter - 240ml caster sugar - 1 whole egg - 2 egg yolks - 5ml vanilla - 240ml sour cream or natural greek yogurt - 720ml flour, sifted - 10ml baking powder - 2ml salt - 240ml jam (strawberry or any flavour) - 1 shot of ouzo, optional instructions 1. preheat oven to 175°c (177°c). 2. cream together the butter and sugar until fluffy and delightful. 3. mix in the egg, egg yolks, vanilla, and yogurt or sour cream. 4. sift in the flour, baking powder, and salt, then fold it all together. 5. reserve a small handful of batter and mix in a little more flour to form a firmer dough for the lattice top. 6. spread the main batter into a greased 9-inch round pan. 7. top generously with jam, using about a cup. 8. roll out the reserved dough and cut strips. 9. brush with leftover egg whites for a glossy finish. 10. bake for around 50 minutes or until golden brown and a knife comes out clean. 11. let it cool.

title: Authentic Hungarian Goulash (Gulyás)
text: authentic hungarian goulash (gulyás) source: daringgourmet.com ingredients - 45ml pork lard (, or butter or bacon grease (pork lard is traditionally used and imparts a great flavor)) - 680g yellow onions (chopped) - 60ml quality genuine imported hungarian sweet paprika - 680g stewing beef ( , cut into 1/2 inch pieces ) - 5 cloves garlic (,minced) - 2 red bell peppers (,seeded/membranes removed, cut into 1/2 inch chunks) - 1 yellow bell pepper (,seeded/membranes removed, cut into 1/2 inch chunks) - 2 tomatoes (,diced) - 2 carrots (,diced) - 2 medium potatoes (,cut into 1/2 inch chunks) - 1200ml beef broth ((traditionally just water is used but beef broth adds so much more flavor)) - 1 bay leaf - 5ml salt - 2ml freshly ground black pepper - 2ml crushed caraway seeds ((optional, not traditional in all regions)) instructions 1. melt the pork lard or butter/oil in a dutch oven or other heavy soup pot over medium high heat and cook the onions until beginning to brown, about 7-10 minutes. add the beef and cook until the beef is just starting to brown, 7-10 minutes. add the bell peppers, tomatoes, and garlic and cook for another 6-8 minutes. remove the pot from the heat and stir in the paprika, salt, pepper and caraway (if using) (note: paprika becomes bitter if at all scorched). add the beef broth, bay leaf, return to the stove and bring to a boil. reduce the heat to medium-low, cover and simmer for 40 minutes. add the carrots and potatoes. return to a boil, reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for another 30-40 minutes or until the beef is nice and tender. add salt to taste. remove the bay leaf.

title: Aviary's Bloody Mary
text: aviary's bloody mary ingredients - 20g fresno chili ice - 10 celery marbles - worcestershire cube - 20g fresno chili ice - 10 celery marbles - 180g bloody mary batch - 3 fresno chilies, stems and seeds removed - 400g water - 25g fresno juice - 14 celery stalks - 18g sugar - 2g kosher salt - 75g worcestershire sauce - 150g water - 1000g heirloom tomatoes - 296g vodka - 39g banyuls vinegar - 25g st. george green chile vodka - 22g grated fresh horseradish - 20g lemon juice - 70g sugar - 14.5g kosher salt - 3g black pepper, coarsely ground instructions 1. extract fresno juice using a juicer or blender and nut milk bag. 2. combine 25g of fresno juice with 400g water and stir to mix thoroughly. 3. pour into a metal tin and freeze completely. 4. using an ice pick, break into small shards and reserve in freezer. 5. boil 14 celery stalks for 1 minute, then transfer to an ice bath to blanch. 6. drain excess water and extract juice using a juicer or blender and nut milk bag. 7. measure 400g celery juice and whisk in 18g sugar and 2g kosher salt. 8. using a syringe or seasoning injector, fill 16mm spherical molds and freeze until completely solid. 9. reserve the celery marbles in the freezer. 10. combine 75g worcestershire sauce and 150g water in a small bowl and mix. 11. fill 1.25" cube ice molds with the mixture and freeze until solid. 12. reserve the worcestershire ice cubes in freezer. 13. preheat oven to 260°c. 14. halve 1000g heirloom tomatoes and place on a sheet tray with a silicone baking mat. 15. roast in oven for 30 minutes and let cool completely. 16. transfer 700g roasted tomatoes to blender. 17. add 296g vodka, 39g banyuls vinegar, 25g st. george green chile vodka, 22g grated fresh horseradish, 20g lemon juice, 70g sugar, and 14.5g kosher salt to the blender. 18. blend on high speed for 1 minute. 19. strain through a nut milk bag or chinois. 20. add 3g black pepper and transfer to a glass bottle. 21. reserve in refrigerator to chill thoroughly. 22. place a metal straw in a chilled collins glass. 23. layer 20g fresno chili ice, 10 celery marbles, worcestershire cube, 20g fresno chili ice, and 10 celery marbles in the glass in that order. 24. pour the bloody mary batch over the contents of the glass and serve.
